newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumo-Japanese wrestlers to tour Australia in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Sumo-Japanese wrestlers to tour Australia in 1997.

text.p: Japan will send its top sumo wrestlers to Australia next June to stage a series of goodwill tournaments to demonstrate the Japanese national sport, Japan Sumo Association officials said on Monday.

The wrestlers, some of whom weigh more than 200 kg (440 lbs), will hold two-day tournaments in Melbourne on June 6-7 and in Sydney on June 13-14 and perform ceremonial rituals during a goodwill visit in Brisbane, the officials said.

The tour, the ninth overseas tour by sumo stars since 1965, is part of a series of events between 1996 and 1998 to commemorate milestones in the development of ties between the key Asian trade and political dialogue partners.

Sumo, a 2,000-year-old form of wrestling which became a professional sport in the 17th century, holds six 15-day tournaments each year in which two hulking men clad in loincloth-like outfits try to throw each other to the ground or out of a cement-hard clay ring.
